meeting.title: Sylvera go-live planning — weekly sync
meeting.summary: Go-live planning for Sylvera. Locked the training schedule, parity checks on the carbon ratings dashboard, launch comms, and enabling the AI analyst for the pilot group.
action_items: Sam to send invites for two developer training sessions by June 30
Tom to finish parity checks on the carbon ratings dashboard against Looker and post results by July 2
Aisha to draft internal launch comms for review by July 3
Ines to enable the AI analyst for the pilot group on July 6
key_decisions: Go-live holds to July 13 provided parity results are clean by July 2
meeting.notes: Everything tracks to the July 13 go-live; parity results on July 2 are the decision gate.

transcript.speaker: Ines Ferreira
transcript.text: Two weeks to target go-live on July 13th, so today is about locking the runway. First: training.

transcript.speaker: Sam Whitfield
transcript.text: We agreed two developer sessions for the ratings team — metrics-as-code workflow, ninety minutes each. I'll schedule the two developer training sessions for the ratings team — invites out by Tuesday, June 30th.

transcript.speaker: Tom Whitmore
transcript.text: Aim for the week of July 6th, that's when the whole team is back from offsite.

transcript.speaker: Sam Whitfield
transcript.text: Will do — sessions that week, invites tomorrow.

transcript.speaker: Ines Ferreira
transcript.text: Next, the big one: parity. Tom, where are the checks on the carbon ratings dashboard?

transcript.speaker: Tom Whitmore
transcript.text: About sixty percent through. Two discrepancies so far and both were timezone handling in the old Looker explore, not your numbers. I'll finish the parity checks on the carbon ratings dashboard against Looker and post results by Thursday, July 2nd.

transcript.speaker: Ines Ferreira
transcript.text: Then July 2nd is our decision gate — clean results and go-live holds at July 13th.

transcript.speaker: Aisha Bello
transcript.text: On comms — people will ask why the Looker links stop working, so we should get ahead of it. I'll draft the internal launch comms and share for review by Friday, July 3rd.

transcript.speaker: Ines Ferreira
transcript.text: Please include the sunset date for the old dashboards in that draft.

transcript.speaker: Sam Whitfield
transcript.text: Last item — the AI analyst. Do we enable it at go-live for everyone or start smaller?

transcript.speaker: Tom Whitmore
transcript.text: Smaller. Pilot group first — the six analysts who did early access.

transcript.speaker: Ines Ferreira
transcript.text: Sensible. I'll enable the AI analyst for the pilot group once training is done — flipping it on Monday, July 6th.

transcript.speaker: Aisha Bello
transcript.text: And wider rollout is a post-go-live conversation, right? Not something we're deciding today.

transcript.speaker: Ines Ferreira
transcript.text: Correct, no commitment on wider rollout today. Good — four owners, four dates. See you all next Monday.
